title_guess: Why the stock market and the real economy move together, and why they can disconnect

segments.teaches: a growing economy pushes the stock market up; the market is seen as a barometer of economic health

elements.what: light-blue band holding the words Economy and Stock Market joined by a dashed two-way arrow
green 'grow' chip above Economy with three small up-arrows
three black up-arrows over the grow chip
row of teal chevrons streaming from Economy to Stock Market
round yellow lens over Stock Market containing a small rising zig-zag line chart
definition hung from the lens by a stem: market as a barometer of the economy
big black ? beside the definition, opening the question 'is it really?'

segments.notes: This top band (economy -> chevrons -> lens chart) stays fixed for the whole video and acts as the anchor; every later segment hangs new content under it.

segments.teaches: reason 1: economic growth raises customer spending, demand rises, company sales and profits rise

elements.what: light-blue heading chip top-left naming reason 1 (increased customer spending)
grey numbered step tabs 1-4 at bottom-left; the current step's tab is raised
short down-arrow from Economy to the first effect
V-shaped chain: spending up -> demand up (bottom) -> sales and profits up (right), joined by slanted arrows

segments.notes: Step-tab progress indicator (1-4) is a recurring device in this video; it is drawn as raised grey tiles, closest kind is tag.

segments.teaches: reason 2: growth improves access to capital, investors fund more and companies expand

elements.what: heading chip swapped to reason 2 (access to capital)
step tabs with tab 2 raised
Economy splits by two slanted arrows into: investors willing to finance / companies willing to expand

segments.notes: Old reason content is removed and new content is drawn in the same slot under the fixed top band.

segments.teaches: reason 3: foreign investors put money into growing markets

elements.what: heading chip swapped to reason 3 (foreign investment)
step tabs with tab 3 raised
down-arrow from Economy
one-line explanation of foreign money chasing growth

segments.teaches: reason 4: growth lifts market sentiment; confident investors buy shares and push prices up

elements.what: heading chip swapped to reason 4 (market sentiment)
step tabs with tab 4 raised
short sentence top-left: growth improves sentiment and confidence
explanation under Economy: positive investors buy more shares
pale yellow box drawn behind the explanation
elbow arrow from the highlighted explanation up to Stock Market

segments.notes: The elbow arrow closes the loop back to the anchor chart: effect visibly lands on the stock market.

segments.teaches: summary: linked in the long run, but short-term fluctuations and disconnects happen

elements.what: three-line summary paragraph under the band
orange text-highlighter on the 'short-term disconnect' phrase
blue text-highlighter on the 'long-term same direction' phrase

segments.notes: Heading chip and step tabs are cleared; only the anchor band stays. Two highlight colours separate the two halves of the conclusion.

segments.teaches: causes of short-term disconnect: company news, optimism about the future, global factors, monetary policy

elements.what: elbow arrow from the orange-highlighted phrase down to a reasons label
yellow letter-spaced 'reasons' chip
square-bullet list of disconnect causes, last row split into two columns

segments.notes: Bullets are added one at a time as the narrator names each cause (plain square bullets, no down-arrows).

elements.what: next-video and playlist panels with app-store promo
